_comment: Santorini locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} intact. Never translate the ASCII {board}, the color names passed as {color}/{winner_color}/etc. (Navy/White/Grey), worker labels (N1, N2, W1, W2, G1, G2), the move token format [worker_id source dest build] / examples like [N1C1C2B2], board coordinates (A-E, 1-5), or level numbers.

_slots.{color}: The player's color/role name (Navy, White or Grey) - do not translate
_slots.{color_initial}: First letter of the player's color, used to build the move token (N, W or G) - do not translate
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board - insert as-is, do not translate
_slots.{valid_moves}: Comma-separated list of valid move tokens - do not translate
_slots.{expected_color}: Color of the worker that was addressed - do not translate
_slots.{player_color}: The acting player's own color - do not translate
_slots.{source}: Source board coordinate, e.g. C2 - do not translate
_slots.{dest}: Destination board coordinate, e.g. C3 - do not translate
_slots.{build}: Build board coordinate, e.g. B2 - do not translate
_slots.{winner_color}: The winning player's color - do not translate
_slots.{loser_color}: The losing player's color - do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
Wena uli kutamba {color} mu michezo ya Santorini.

Mvila ya Michezo:
1. Kuendelea:
   - Vatamba vangana kuenda kwa miraba iliyo karibu (kujumuisha diagonal)
   - Vatamba vangana kwenda kwa miraba iliyo na vatamba vingine au kupala
   - Vatamba vangana kupanda kiwango kimoja, lakini vangana kushuka kiwango chochote

2. Kujenga:
   - Lazima mujenge kwa mraba ulio karibu na ambapo mtumaji wako alienda
   - Vatamba vangana kujenga ambapo mtumaji yeyote aliwima
   - Vatamba vangana kujenga juu ya kupala (kiwango 4)
   - Kujenga kuongeza kiwango kimoja (au kuunda kupala kwa kiwango 3)

3. Masharti ya Kushinda:
   - Ushinde kwa kuhamisha mtumaji hadi kiwango 3
   - Ushinde ikiwa mshindani hana michezo halali

Fanya mchezo wako kwa umbo [worker_id source dest build]
Mfano: [{color_initial}1C1C2B2] inamaanisha hamisha {color} mtumaji 1 kutoka C1 hadi C2 na ujenzi kwa B2
Unaweza kuongeza maandishi zaidi katika ujumbe wako, lakini lazima utaje tu muundo wa mchezo halali mara moja.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umbo la mchezo si sahihi. Umbo unalotarajiwa: [worker_id source dest build], kwa mfano [N1C1C2B2]

game_action.moved: Mchezaji {player_id} ({color}) alihamisha mtumaji {worker_num} kutoka {source} hadi {dest} na ujenzi kwa {build}

outcome.win_level3: Mchezaji {winner_id} ({winner_color}) alishinda kwa kuhamisha mtumaji hadi kiwango 3!
outcome.no_moves: Mchezaji {loser_id} ({loser_color}) hana michezo halali. Mchezaji {winner_id} ({winner_color}) anashinda!
